steps.content: The song ends, and the shrill sound makes you dizzy.
How's that? Are you awake? My suona is unmatched, so you must feel refreshed and delighted.
What you just heard is worth 10,000 DisCoins. So pay up!
Don't try to change the subject! What Sinner? I saved you, and you need to pay up.
Or... are you thinking about using those red spikes on me. You don't want to pay me?!
She knows about the shackles?! Are you exposed?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I don't want to hurt you.
I don't know what you're talking about.

steps.content: Haha, haha! Liar, you just don't want a war with Drifter Camp.
Haha, haha, so pretentious! Aren't you here to make peace with Drifter Camp? Now, where's your peace offering?
I know what you're thinking, "She's the only one here. No one will know. I can do whatever I want... blast the board off with Potestas and use the shackles on her!"
You can sense through the shackles that the Sinners are getting closer. You stop being led by her little tricks and begin to stall.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Where did you learn about me?

steps.content: Hmph... I am the all-knowing, the past, the future, everything there is!
You woke up not long ago, destroyed BR-004, wiped out the Corpseborne, and took out the two leaders of the Legion.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm not an enemy of the Legion.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They are my friends. I tried to save them and failed. But I don't want to fail a second time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I have come to stop those who seek to harm Syndicans, and I am not your enemy.
Hmph... I know that too.
The Legion doesn't hate you. In their eyes, you're a friend, a good person, and you've done your best.
She says this with some tenderness.
The murmuring gets closer. It's like a hand caressing you through the cold board.
They said it themselves... It's the last message they left to this world... Want to know what they said?
It carries you, steadfast, through the rain of cinders.
Okay, okay, that's enough talking. You won't be getting another word from me without paying the bill.
Just as she's having fun, there's a boom, followed by a whirring sound. Something is blown away, rolling around on the ground.
The board suddenly gets lighter. You easily push it open and sit up, but the dim light dazzles your eyes. At the same time, you hear a familiar voice...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!
The Nightmare leaps straight down from a high place with Hecate in its palms, stopping between you and the person knocked aside. You breathe a sigh of relief.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She got trapped.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't worry, she's fine. I'll go back and untie her when we get this sorted out.
Sitting next to the wooden box is a girl in strange attire. She rubs her head and gets up, still clutching a peculiar instrument.

steps.speaker: Strange Girl
steps.content: Woah... Why so aggressive? I was just joking with him, okay?
steps.female_content: Woah... Why so aggressive? I was just joking with her, okay?

steps.speaker: Strange Girl
steps.content: I don't really want to fight you. It's not like I have the power. I just wanted to join the fun, so don't get mad, okay?

steps.speaker: Strange Girl
steps.content: Didn't you say you wanted a talk with the Drifter Camp? I'll help you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I don't want to talk to you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The plan has changed. Now I have to hide my identity. And you know too much, Sinner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know too much, and you've crossed the line, Sinner.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Should we capture her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just need to put shackles on her. I can't trust her, and we need to keep her quiet.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Got it.

steps.speaker: Strange Girl
steps.content: Haha, can't get a deal and want to get rough? Not going to work!
She blows the instrument in her hand violently, and the piercing waves of sound actually repel the attacking Nightmare for a moment, echoing in the midst of this towering patio.

You and Hecate are a little shaken for a moment. The echoes are slow to subside... No, it's not a constant echo, it's people coming from all directions. You hurriedly take off your Bureau jacket and carry it in your arms.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...The Drifter Camp Force?! Are we exposed?
She leans to the side to avoid a pan that spins down from upstairs.

steps.speaker: Resident
steps.content: So noisy!!! Shattered my cooking pot!

steps.speaker: Resident
steps.content: Dudu, what is it this time?!
The girl called Dudu chuckles.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Want to catch me? Do you know where you are? This is my turf.
She suddenly cranes her neck and shouts...

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Help! Intruders! Intruders are attacking Drifter Camp!!!
